associations.rationale: Defines the claimed canonical evaluation map from the direct sum of Hom_A(X,V) tensor X summands to V.
States that the direct-sum evaluation map sends the included pure tensor g tensor x to g(x), exactly the claimed value formula.
Defines evaluation on one Hom_A(X,V) tensor X summand, a construction used by the claimed direct-sum map.
Proves the pure-tensor formula for the single-summand evaluator, supporting the direct-sum computation claim.
